# R Script Following Steps from Vignette

## Installing Dependencies

*!!! IMPORTANT NOTE !!!*

*Source the `functions/environment_setup.R` script first in the R
environment to install `dplyr`, `BioConductor`, and `CoSIA` as packages.
They were removed from the R Notebooks to reduce time and complexity of
rendering*

```{r install-dependencies, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
beginning_time <- Sys.time()
library(dplyr)
library(CoSIA)
```

## Loading Monogenic Kidney Genes as sample genes to use

```{r loading-gene-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
load("../inst/extdata/proccessed/monogenic_kidney_genes.rda")
set.seed(42)
monogenic_kid_sample <- dplyr::sample_n(monogenic_kidney_genes, 20)
monogenic_kid_sample
```

## Get Tissues For Species

> Quote from vignette: To compare across all shared tissues for your
> selected species, you can assign the `getTissues` output to an object
> as input for map_tissues when initializing a `CoSIAn` object.

notes:

- "_r_noregicus_: in the vignette options in (#tab:Table1.) is
"_r_norvegicus_"\
- Saving the results of `CoSIA::getTissues` into a variable. However,
the walk through of the vignette is not using it.\
- Vignette example is using human and rat in initial configuration,
however the later gene expression visualized also includes mouse, so am
including mouse as output species

```{r gathering-tissue-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
output_species <- c("h_sapiens", "r_norvegicus", "m_musculus")
map_tissues <- CoSIA::getTissues(output_species)
```

## Configuring the base CoSIA package like in vignette 1.2.4

notes:

- Not using all the tissues in this example, just `adult mammalian kidney & heart`\
- Using mouse, rat, human as output species to generate matching gene
expression plot later in vignette walk through

todo: Read manual for the map_species parameter

```{r cosia-initialize}
CoSIAn_Obj_Vignette = CoSIA::CoSIAn(
  gene_set = unique(monogenic_kid_sample$Gene),
  i_species = "h_sapiens",
  o_species = c(
    "h_sapiens",
    "r_norvegicus",
    "m_musculus"
  ),
  input_id = "Symbol",
  output_ids = "Ensembl_id",
  map_species = c(
    "h_sapiens",
    "r_norvegicus",
    "m_musculus"
  ),
  map_tissues = c(
    "adult mammalian kidney",
    "heart"
  ),
  mapping_tool = "annotationDBI",
  ortholog_database = "HomoloGene",
  metric_type = "CV_Species" # Calculating it across species
)
```

## Calculating species unique identifier mappings based on input gene symbol

```{r cosia-id-mapping}
CoSIAn_Obj_Vignette_convert <- CoSIA::getConversion(CoSIAn_Obj_Vignette)
head(CoSIA::viewCoSIAn(CoSIAn_Obj_Vignette_convert, "converted_id"))
```

## Gene Expression for Human and Rat

```{r gene-expression-human-rat-mammalian-kidney-taco1-gene}
CoSIAn_Obj_gex <- CoSIA::getGEx(CoSIAn_Obj_Vignette_convert)
CoSIAn_Obj_gexplot <- CoSIA::plotSpeciesGEx(CoSIAn_Obj_gex, "adult mammalian kidney", "ENSG00000136463")
CoSIAn_Obj_gexplot
```

Aiming for the previous figure to render similarly to the following
vignette figure

<img src="../inst/images/CoSIA_vignette_gex_TACO1.png" alt="Figure: Gene Expression of TACO1 in Kidney Across Selected Species" width="703"/>

## Coefficient of Variation for Human and Rat Tissue

note: \# metric_type = "CV_Species"

```{r coefficient-of-variation-human-rat-tissue,  dpi=200, fig.height=13, fig.width=6 }
CoSIA_Vignette_coefficient_variation_human_rat_tissue <- CoSIA::getGExMetrics(CoSIAn_Obj_Vignette_convert)
CoSIA_Vignette_coefficient_variation_plot_tissue <- CoSIA::plotCVGEx(CoSIA_Vignette_coefficient_variation_human_rat_tissue)
CoSIA_Vignette_coefficient_variation_plot_tissue

end_time <- Sys.time()

time.loop <- end_time - beginning_time
cat("Time elapsed: ", round((time.loop),3), " minutes")
```
